title: Rippling Force Mail

sources.title: Force Conduit
markers: only triggered after a melee attack

summary: AC 17 Heavy Armour that builds Force Conduit when you take physical damage.

fields.Armour Class: 17. Heavy Armour proficiency and disadvantage on Stealth checks.
fields.Force Absorption: Taking at least 1 Bludgeoning, Piercing or Slashing damage grants 2 turns of Force Conduit. Falling, redirected Warding Bond damage and qualifying self-damage can count. Damage reduced to 0 does not trigger it.
fields.Force Conduit: Reduces incoming Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing by 1 per remaining turn, up to 7. At 5 or more turns, a damaging melee hit that gets through triggers 1d4 Force in a 20 ft radius and consumes the stacks. This armour then restores 2 turns. Redirected Warding Bond damage can be reduced but does not trigger the burst. The burst can trigger Arcane Echomalefaction and Coldbrim Chill on enemies.
fields.Acquisition: Locked rustic chest upstairs in Dammon’s Last Light Inn smithy, X −22, Y 175.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
